--- flash 0xB000-0xB094 UART3 只读常量表 (DATA_SEGMENT §5) ---
  0xB00C = 0x2009C000 (537509888)  UART3基址
  0xB010 = 0x400FC0C4 (1074774212)  PCONP掩码
  0xB014 = 0x400FC000 (1074774016)  外设时钟reg
  0xB018 = 0x4002C000 (1073922048)  PCLKSEL reg
  0xB01C = 0x10001704 (268441348)  数据位索引
  0xB020 = 0x4009C000 (1074380800)  UART3 reg区(0x4009C000+0)
  0xB024 = 0x10001700 (268441344)  波特率索引指针
  0xB028 = 0x100017BC (268441532)  波特率表指针
  0xB02C = 0x0016E360 (1500000)  PCLK基准=1500000
